page.notes: The abbreviation mark after "ejusq", "variaeq", "illius q" and "casib.quidq" is a superscript figure-3 shape; transcribed as printed with q; and may be a slightly different sign. Some marks over "illarū" and "illorū" are macrons read with reasonable confidence. The rendering of the drop-cap "T" in "Talionis" is a large initial; the following letter is shown as a small capital A and read as "Talionis". No printing errors were identified.
